items.q: What kind of events does Nahim speak at?
items.a: Conferences, staff and leadership days, award evenings, school and university sessions, community events and panels. He’s spoken to rooms of twenty and rooms of several hundred.
Yes. He’ll want a conversation with you first about who’s in the room and what you’re hoping they leave with. The core story stays the same; the emphasis changes.
Yes, keynotes and panels can be delivered online. In-person is his preference where possible, for obvious reasons.

It depends on the format, length, location and the type of organisation. Charities, schools and youth organisations are treated differently to corporates. Use the form and he’ll come back with a straight answer.
London. He travels across the UK and is happy to discuss events further afield.
